title: Supply active campaign rules and source ambiguities to DM context
description:
Objective
Make the primary DM receive the complete active campaign-rule prose set and relevant immutable rules-pack ambiguity metadata at the adjudicated campaign position.

Required behavior
At initial scale, supply all active campaign-rule prose on every applicable DM turn; correctness takes priority over selective retrieval. Include stable rule identity, kind, effective provenance, and linked ambiguity/interpretation provenance without asking the model to execute deterministic state logic. When a relevant RulesAmbiguity has no active campaign ruling, the context must preserve uncertainty and prohibit silent canonical certainty. Context assembly must use the same active-at-position query that the auditor will use.

Architecture and references
Follow ADR 0017 and docs/rules-pack-compiler.md. Consume PR #419 mechanics.ambiguities / RulesAmbiguity output from eshyra-o9bd.18.7.9. Reuse existing rules-stack lookup and campaign binding rather than copying pack data into campaign state.

Non-goals
No persistence workflow, player dialogue policy, implicit precedent creation, prompt retrieval optimization, arbitrary house-rule inference, or prose-to-mechanics compilation. Ordinary contextual DM judgments do not become campaign rules.
acceptance_criteria:
DM context contains all and only rules active at the current campaign position in deterministic order; relevant unresolved RulesAmbiguity metadata is available without a preferred/default winner; tests prove prospective/effective-turn filtering and no silent canonical certainty; no campaign prose is written to the pack.

ADR 0020 TRANSITION AMENDMENT A1 (integrated transition design section 8.3, R4;
accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8, PR #485, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282): the active-rule projection must
expose, per rule, enough association data to place an active campaign rule or
ruling beside its governing pack record or source ambiguity - the linked
ambiguity ID and, where one exists, the governing pack record key - so a
consumer can pair rule and source material without re-deriving the association.
This extends the projection only; the eshyra-jhpt.1 domain model, which already
requires a ruling to record the ambiguity ID and selected interpretation ID as
provenance, is unchanged.

The discovery-side consumer is eshyra-o9bd.19.13 (transition W11), which depends
on this output and may not substitute a discovery-local campaign-rule or ruling
store, cache of record, or shadow resolver. Campaign-rule persistence, ruling
schema, active-rule resolution, supersession, revocation, and house-rule
lifecycle remain owned here. If the projection proves insufficient for the
consumer, the correct response is an amendment or a new child under eshyra-jhpt.
notes:
Supervisor review of attempt 1 (935d7d9): migration 0026, resolveCampaignPosition idempotency, and critically the position-before-SAVEPOINT placement in runTurn (which preserves a replayed turn's position for .8) are ACCEPTED, as is assembleCampaignRulesContext as the shared DM/auditor projection. Per-turn pack scan measured at ~0.13ms/1812 records - not a concern. Four findings: (1) PRIMARY - only the position idempotency test was added; assembleCampaignRulesContext and the rendered section have no tests at all, leaving prospective/effective filtering, supersession/revocation, ordering, A1 association data, all three ambiguities unresolved, ruling-beside-source, and pack immutability unproven; (2) assembleContext silently returns an empty rules context when campaignPosition is omitted, reintroducing at the context layer the trap .2 removed at the store layer - latent today since runTurn always passes it, but it makes .4 DM/auditor divergence silent; (3) localeCompare in ambiguity ordering - verified NOT currently mis-ordering the three shipped ids, but locale/ICU-dependent and the same construct removed in .1; (4) plain Error instead of CampaignRuleError. Attempt 2 dispatched as eshyra-jhpt.3.2.
Attempt 2 (c3db41c) reviewed and ACCEPTED: consolidated projection test covers all eight required cases, campaignPosition required on ContextAssemblyInput, codepoint ambiguity ordering, CampaignRuleError. One further finding: the position is still an unvalidated raw string passed to SQL, and canonical positions start with 'cp1~', so any later-sorting string satisfies effective_position <= ? for every row - reproduced with the 'test-position' sentinel attempt 2 introduced in ~10 assembleContext call sites (cp1~000000000999~s~t <= 'test-position' is true). That resurrects the .2 future-rule leak through a different door; it is inert only because those tests hold no rules. Attempt 3 dispatched as eshyra-jhpt.3.3 to parse/validate at the store boundary and replace the sentinels.
Attempt 3 (74f28bd) ACCEPTED: all position-taking store entry points parse/canonicalize and reject malformed values with CampaignRuleError. However supervisor found attempt 3 missed packages/cli/test/play.test.ts, which still holds three 'test-position' sentinels. Those did not fail because of a VERIFICATION-INTEGRITY problem, now filed as eshyra-3dmq: a linked worktree has no node_modules, so packages/cli tests resolve @eshyra/core UP to the parent checkout (main) and never saw any jhpt change. After npm ci in the worktree plus a rebuild, play.test.ts fails 2 tests with CampaignRuleError: invalid campaign position 'test-position'. Every verify:worktree run on this epic so far was green for CLI tests against main's core; core tests are unaffected because they import via relative ../src paths, and typecheck is unaffected because tsc --build compiles from source. Attempt 4 dispatched as eshyra-jhpt.3.4, with npm ci mandated before verification. PR for .1-.3 is held until this is green under correct resolution.
